market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham United have consistently been a mid-table Premier League side with strong financial backing and a squad depth that rarely places them in genuine relegation battles. The 34.5% implied probability is far higher than historical relegation rates for comparable clubs, even accounting for uncertainty two seasons out. I estimate a true relegation chance of roughly 15%, making the No side mispriced.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023–24 and have not been relegated since 2010–11, with their only recent near-miss in 2019–20 (still 5 points clear).
Mid-table Premier League clubs of similar stature historically face relegation only about 5–10% of the time in a given season, even before adjusting for squad quality.
The 2025–26 season is two years away, but West Ham’s infrastructure and investment profile make a sudden collapse unlikely without extraordinary circumstances.
